about: Fourth picture pass for the hauntings documentary (fetch.py --extra, Oct. 21, 2026): a sharp copy of Anthony Finley's 1827 map of Indiana ("Pottawatomie Indians" across the north) from Wikimedia Commons, and full-size cut-outs of the 1862 county map from the Library of Congress: Galena Township (the Methodist church where Posey Chapel's cemetery is today), the state prison as drawn in 1862, and the map's title. Same rules: public domain, CC0 or CC BY only.
